<!--
================================================================================
 diph_sitrep_pptx.Rmd
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Companion to diph_sitrep.qmd / .Rmd. Builds a STATIC PowerPoint deck in which
 every figure/table is EMBEDDED directly (no external links, no "Update Links"
 step). Re-run this file (or source 00_Run the report.R) to regenerate the deck.

 Approach (approved):
   * Single officer build (one engine).
   * Title slide + Highlights slide  = NATIVE, EDITABLE PowerPoint text.
   * Summary table, epicurve, map, pyramid, CFR, trend, cumulative table
                                     = pixel-placed EMBEDDED images.
   * Slide titles are AUTO-DERIVED from the fig/table title objects in
     0_header.R (single source of truth), with the "Figure N:/Table N:" prefix
     and trailing week/year tokens stripped.
   * Template: presentations/templates/NCDC template.pptx (layouts/masters
     reused; its own example slides are removed at build time and rebuilt from
     the R outputs).

 Output: presentations/Diphtheria_Sitrep_<YYYY>_W<##>.pptx
 (the linked deck keeps the "_linked" suffix, so the two never collide).

 The HTML that this Rmd knits to is just a build log; the real deliverable is
 the .pptx written to presentations/.
================================================================================
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, include = TRUE, warning = FALSE,
                      message = FALSE, dpi = 300)

# ---- report_date ------------------------------------------------------------

# report_date already in the environment (e.g. set by 00_Run the report.R or a

.rd <- NULL

  .rd <- params$report_date
} else if (exists("report_date")) {
  .rd <- report_date
}
if (is.null(.rd))
  stop("report_date not supplied - pass it via params (rmarkdown::render(..., ",
       "params = list(report_date = ...))) or define it before knitting.")
report_date <- as.Date(.rd)

# Source the SAME scripts in the SAME order as the sitrep, so every figure,

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(officer)
```

```{r build}
# =============================================================================
# 1. Constants
# =============================================================================
template_path <- here::here("presentations", "templates", "NCDC template.pptx")

master_name   <- "NCDC Template (Training Module)"  # the branded master
layout_title  <- "Title Slide with Sub-heading"
layout_body   <- "Title and Content"

# Safe image box (inches). Sits just below the title placeholder (which ends at
# ~1.85in) so a 1-2 line auto-derived title never overlaps the image.
BOX <- list(left = 0.60, top = 1.90, width = 12.13, height = 4.75)

img_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "diph_pptx_img")  # temp: images are embedded,
if (!dir.exists(img_dir)) dir.create(img_dir)     # so nothing lingers on disk

# =============================================================================
# 2. Helpers
# =============================================================================

# ragg-based ggsave (default png() on Windows can render a black bottom half).
save_plot <- function(plot_obj, file, w, h, dpi = 200) {
  path <- file.path(img_dir, file)
  ggplot2::ggsave(path, plot = plot_obj, width = w, height = h, units = "in",
                  dpi = dpi, bg = "white", device = ragg::agg_png)
  path
}

save_ft <- function(ft, file) {
  path <- file.path(img_dir, file)
  flextable::save_as_image(x = ft, path = path)
  path
}

# Native pixel dimensions of a PNG, in inches (assuming it was written at `dpi`).
img_dim_in <- function(path, dpi = 200) {
  d <- dim(png::readPNG(path))          # rows (height px), cols (width px)
  list(w = d[2] / dpi, h = d[1] / dpi)
}

# Fit (w_in x h_in) inside BOX preserving aspect ratio; centre horizontally,
# anchor to the top of the box. Returns a ph_location.
fit_location <- function(w_in, h_in, box = BOX) {
  s   <- min(box$width / w_in, box$height / h_in)
  w   <- w_in * s
  h   <- h_in * s
  ph_location(left  = box$left + (box$width - w) / 2,
              top   = box$top,
              width = w, height = h)
}

# Place a pre-sized image that already matches the box aspect (fills the box).
loc_fill <- function() ph_location(left = BOX$left, top = BOX$top,
                                   width = BOX$width, height = BOX$height)

# Trim near-white whitespace from a PNG: (1) crop to non-white bounding box,
# (2) collapse tall interior all-white bands (e.g. gap above a map scale bar).
trim_white <- function(path, pad = 8, tol = 250/255, max_gap = 18) {
  img <- png::readPNG(path)
  if (length(dim(img)) != 3) return(invisible(NULL))
  vis <- !(img[,,1] >= tol & img[,,2] >= tol & img[,,3] >= tol)
  if (!any(vis)) return(invisible(NULL))
  rows <- which(apply(vis, 1, any)); cols <- which(apply(vis, 2, any))
  H <- nrow(vis); W <- ncol(vis)
  r1 <- max(1, min(rows) - pad); r2 <- min(H, max(rows) + pad)
  c1 <- max(1, min(cols) - pad); c2 <- min(W, max(cols) + pad)
  img <- img[r1:r2, c1:c2, , drop = FALSE]
  H2 <- nrow(img)
  white_row <- apply(img[,,1] >= tol & img[,,2] >= tol & img[,,3] >= tol, 1, all)
  keep <- rep(TRUE, H2); i <- 1L; removed <- 0L
  while (i <= H2) {
    if (white_row[i]) {
      s <- i; while (i <= H2 && white_row[i]) i <- i + 1L; e <- i - 1L
      gap <- e - s + 1L
      if (gap > max_gap) {
        excess <- gap - max_gap; mid <- s + max_gap %/% 2L
        keep[seq.int(mid, length.out = excess)] <- FALSE; removed <- removed + excess
      }
    } else i <- i + 1L
  }
  if (removed > 0L) img <- img[keep, , , drop = FALSE]
  png::writePNG(img, target = path)
}

# Turn a fig/table title object into a slide title: drop "Figure N:/Table N:"
# and peel trailing week / year / "YYYY cumulative through week N" / range /
# "for YYYY" tokens until stable.
clean_title <- function(x) {
  t <- if (inherits(x, "ftext")) x$value else as.character(x)
  t <- sub("^\\s*(Figure|Table)\\s*\\d+\\s*[:.]?\\s*", "", t, ignore.case = TRUE)
  repeat {
    before <- t
    t <- sub("[,;]?\\s*\\d{4}\\s*cumulative\\s*through\\s*(epi\\s*)?week\\s*\\d+\\s*$",
             "", t, ignore.case = TRUE)
    t <- sub("[,;]?\\s*\\d{4}\\s*[-–]\\s*\\d{4}\\s*$", "", t)   # 2022 - 2026
    t <- sub("\\s*for\\s*\\d{4}\\s*$", "", t, ignore.case = TRUE)     # for 2026
    t <- sub("[,;]?\\s*(epi\\s*)?week\\s*\\d+\\s*$", "", t, ignore.case = TRUE)
    t <- sub("[,;]?\\s*\\d{4}\\s*$", "", t)                          # trailing year
    t <- sub("[[:space:],;.]+$", "", t)   # trailing punctuation/space only
    if (identical(before, t)) break
  }
  # Interior cleanup: some titles embed the week/year mid-string (e.g. the
  # summary table). Drop interior "week N" and year tokens, then tidy the
  # empty comma slots they leave behind, so the slide title stays to <=2 lines.
  t <- gsub("\\s*(epi\\s*)?week\\s*\\d+", "", t, ignore.case = TRUE)
  t <- gsub("\\s*\\b(19|20)\\d{2}\\b", "", t)
  t <- gsub("\\s*,(\\s*,)+", ",", t)     # collapse ", ,"/", , ," runs
  t <- gsub("\\s+,", ",", t)
  t <- gsub("\\s{2,}", " ", t)
  t <- sub("^[[:space:],;.]+", "", t)
  t <- sub("[[:space:],;.]+$", "", t)
  trimws(t)
}

# =============================================================================
# 3. Export figures / tables to (temp) PNGs
# =============================================================================
# PPT-only font bump for the charts (slides 4, 6-8): axis titles, axis text,
# legend text and legend title all to 14 pt. Applied here so it affects the
# deck only - the Word report re-renders the same objects without this override.
# `+ theme()` overrides size only and keeps each chart's bold/angle/colour.
bump <- theme(
  axis.title   = element_text(size = 14),
  axis.text    = element_text(size = 14),
  legend.text  = element_text(size = 14),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 14)
)

# ggplots that fill the box (rendered at the box aspect):
p_epicurve <- save_plot(epicurve         + bump, "epicurve.png", BOX$width, BOX$height)
p_vacc_sta <- save_plot(vacc_sta_2026         + bump, "vacc_sta.png", BOX$width, BOX$height)
p_pyramid  <- save_plot(age_pyramid_plot + bump, "pyramid.png",  BOX$width, BOX$height)
p_cfr      <- save_plot(combo_chart      + bump, "cfr.png",      BOX$width, BOX$height)
p_trend    <- save_plot(trend_year_plot  + bump, "trend.png",    BOX$width, BOX$height)

# map (slide 5): NOT bumped. Render near-square, then trim whitespace and fit.
p_map      <- save_plot(diph_map,         "map.png",        8.5, BOX$height)
trim_white(p_map)

# Summary table (slide 2): rasterised image. PPT-only tweaks so the two-line
# "States & LGAs affected" header and its "States: X / LGAs: Y" cells don't
# overlap: widen that column and open up the line spacing. (Word untouched.)
# Column widths tuned so every header fits on TWO lines (no 3-4 line wrapping),
# which also shortens the header row. Widths are relative (the image is scaled
# to the slide), sized for the widest header line in each column:
#          Reporting Suspected Confirmed (suspected) CaseFatality States&LGAs
summary_w <- c(0.95,     0.95,     0.95,     1.10,       1.30,        1.30)
summary_ppt <- Summary_table_ft |>
  flextable::line_spacing(space = 1.3, part = "all") |>
  flextable::width(j = 1:6, width = summary_w) |>
  flextable::fix_border_issues()
p_summary  <- save_ft(summary_ppt, "summary.png")

# Monthly table (slide 9): rasterised image, same approach as summary table.
# Column widths tuned so headers fit on two lines without wrapping to three.
#           Month  Epi-Wks  Suspected  Deaths  CFR    States  LGAs
# monthly_w <- c(0.90,  0.80,    1.10,     0.80,   0.90,  1.10,   1.00)
# monthly_ppt <- monthly_diph_tbl |>
#   flextable::line_spacing(space = 1.3, part = "all") |>
#   flextable::width(j = 1:7, width = monthly_w) |>
#   flextable::fix_border_issues()
# p_monthly <- save_ft(monthly_ppt, "monthly.png")

# =============================================================================
# 4. Slide titles (auto-derived) and subtitle
# =============================================================================
main_title <- "Diphtheria Situation Report"
sub_title  <- paste0(week_n, ": ", week_period)   # mirrors the Word title row 2

ttl_summary <- clean_title(table1)      # inner ftext of table1_title
ttl_epi     <- clean_title(fig1_title)
ttl_vacc     <- clean_title(fig2_title)
ttl_map     <- clean_title(fig3_title)
ttl_pyr     <- clean_title(fig4_title)
ttl_cfr     <- clean_title(fig5_title)
ttl_trend   <- clean_title(fig6_title)
# ttl_monthly <- clean_title(table2)     # monthly indicators table

# Highlights: same lines as the report (glue objects coerced to character),
# plus the standing TWG line that the Rmd hard-codes.
highlight_lines <- c(
  as.character(highlight1), as.character(highlight2), as.character(highlight3),
  as.character(highlight4), as.character(highlight5), as.character(highlight6),
  as.character(highlight7),
  paste0("National Diphtheria multi-partner, multi-sectoral Technical Working ",
         "Group (TWG) continues coordinating the response activities at all levels")
)

mk_bullets <- function(lines, size = 17) {
  ft <- fp_text(font.family = "Arial", font.size = size, color = "#000000")
  pp <- fp_par(text.align = "left", padding.bottom = 8)
  do.call(block_list,
          lapply(lines, function(s) fpar(ftext(paste0("•  ", s), ft), fp_p = pp)))
}

# =============================================================================
# 5. Build the deck
# =============================================================================
doc <- read_pptx(template_path)

# Remove the template's own example slides; keep its masters/layouts.
while (length(doc) > 0) doc <- remove_slide(doc, index = 1)

add_img <- function(doc, title, path, fill = FALSE) {
  loc <- if (fill) loc_fill() else { d <- img_dim_in(path); fit_location(d$w, d$h) }
  doc <- add_slide(doc, layout = layout_body, master = master_name)
  doc <- ph_with(doc, value = title, location = ph_location_type("title"))
  ph_with(doc, value = external_img(path), location = loc, use_loc_size = TRUE)
}

# --- Slide 1: title (native text) --------------------------------------------
doc <- add_slide(doc, layout = layout_title, master = master_name)
doc <- ph_with(doc, value = main_title, location = ph_location_type("ctrTitle"))
doc <- ph_with(doc, value = sub_title,  location = ph_location_type("subTitle"))

# --- Slide 2: summary table (image) + linked footnote ------------------------
# Fit the table into the safe box (top-anchored, centred) and remember its
# placed height so the footnote can sit directly beneath it.
s2_dim <- img_dim_in(p_summary)
s2_scl <- min(BOX$width / s2_dim$w, BOX$height / s2_dim$h)
s2_w   <- s2_dim$w * s2_scl
s2_h   <- s2_dim$h * s2_scl
s2_l   <- BOX$left + (BOX$width - s2_w) / 2
doc <- add_slide(doc, layout = layout_body, master = master_name)
doc <- ph_with(doc, value = ttl_summary, location = ph_location_type("title"))
doc <- ph_with(doc, value = external_img(p_summary),
               location = ph_location(left = s2_l, top = BOX$top,
                                      width = s2_w, height = s2_h),
               use_loc_size = TRUE)
# Footnote pinned near the bottom of the slide, just above the green footer bar
# (which starts at ~6.9in). Text comes from footnote_confirmed (0_header.R), so
# editing it there updates the report AND this slide.
doc <- ph_with(doc,
               value = fpar(ftext(paste0("¹ ", footnote_confirmed),
                                  fp_text(font.family = "Arial", font.size = 14,
                                          italic = TRUE, color = "#000000"))),
               location = ph_location(left = s2_l, top = 6.55,
                                      width = s2_w, height = 0.30))

# --- Slide 3: highlights (native editable text) ------------------------------
doc <- add_slide(doc, layout = layout_body, master = master_name)
doc <- ph_with(doc, value = "Highlights", location = ph_location_type("title"))
doc <- ph_with(doc, value = mk_bullets(highlight_lines),
               location = ph_location(left = BOX$left, top = BOX$top,
                                      width = BOX$width, height = BOX$height))

# --- Slides 4-8: figures (images) --------------------------------------------
doc <- add_img(doc, ttl_epi,   p_epicurve, fill = TRUE)
doc <- add_img(doc, ttl_vacc,   p_vacc_sta, fill = TRUE)
doc <- add_img(doc, ttl_map,   p_map)                 # fitted (trimmed, centred)
doc <- add_img(doc, ttl_pyr,   p_pyramid,  fill = TRUE)
doc <- add_img(doc, ttl_cfr,   p_cfr,      fill = TRUE)
doc <- add_img(doc, ttl_trend, p_trend,    fill = TRUE)

# # --- Slide 9: monthly indicators table (image) -------------------------------
# m9_dim <- img_dim_in(p_monthly)
# m9_scl <- min(BOX$width / m9_dim$w, BOX$height / m9_dim$h)
# m9_w   <- m9_dim$w * m9_scl
# m9_h   <- m9_dim$h * m9_scl
# m9_l   <- BOX$left + (BOX$width - m9_w) / 2
# doc <- add_slide(doc, layout = layout_body, master = master_name)
# doc <- ph_with(doc, value = ttl_monthly, location = ph_location_type("title"))
# doc <- ph_with(doc, value = external_img(p_monthly),
#                location = ph_location(left = m9_l, top = BOX$top,
#                                       width = m9_w, height = m9_h),
#                use_loc_size = TRUE)

# --- Slide 10-11: key activities and recommendations -------------------------
doc <- add_slide(doc, layout = layout_body, master = master_name)
doc <- ph_with(doc, value = "Key activities", location = ph_location_type("title"))
doc <- ph_with(doc, value = "",               location = ph_location_type("body"))

doc <- add_slide(doc, layout = layout_body, master = master_name)
doc <- ph_with(doc, value = "Recommendations and challenges", location = ph_location_type("title"))
doc <- ph_with(doc, value = "",               location = ph_location_type("body"))

# =============================================================================
# 6. Save
# =============================================================================
out_name <- paste0("Diphtheria_Sitrep_",
                   lubridate::isoyear(report_date), "_W",
                   sprintf("%02d", lubridate::isoweek(report_date)), ".pptx")
out_path <- here::here("presentations", out_name)
print(doc, target = out_path)
message("PowerPoint written to: ", out_path)
```

**Static PowerPoint built:** `` `r out_name` `` (`r length(doc)` slides) in the `report/` folder.
Re-run `00_Run the report.R` (or knit this file) after changing `report_date` to refresh it.
